description:
The Electrical Engineering Calculations app is open on the main menu screen. Your task:
1. Scroll down to the 'Lighting Calculations' section.
2. Tap 'Lumens to Lux' to open the Lumens to Lux converter.
3. Enter a Luminous Flux of 800 lumens.
4. Enter an Area of 10 square meters.
5. Tap the CALCULATE button.
6. Verify that the result shows 80 Lux (since Lux = Lumens / Area = 800 / 10 = 80).
